description: This Java source file defines the DispatchContext class, which manages service dispatching, caching, and related operations within the Apache OFBiz framework. It includes methods for retrieving services, generating WSDL documents, and handling service configuration.

classes.name: DispatchContext
classes.description: Manages service dispatching, caching, and configuration within the OFBiz framework. Provides methods for retrieving services, generating WSDLs, and handling service context validation.

methods.name: DispatchContext
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the DispatchContext with a name, class loader, and dispatcher, and sets up service cache.

methods.name: getClassLoader
methods.description: Returns the class loader associated with this context.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of this DispatchContext.

methods.name: getDispatcher
methods.description: Returns the LocalDispatcher associated with this context.

methods.name: getDelegator
methods.description: Returns the Delegator associated with the dispatcher.

methods.name: getSecurity
methods.description: Returns the Security object associated with the dispatcher.

methods.name: makeValidContext
methods.description: Creates a map of valid input/output parameters for a given service based on its ModelService definition.

methods.name: getModelService
methods.description: Retrieves the ModelService object for a given service name.

methods.name: getAllServiceNames
methods.description: Returns a set of all available service names.

methods.name: getWSDL
methods.description: Generates and returns the WSDL Document for a specified service.

methods.name: createServiceReaderCallable
methods.description: Creates a callable task to load service models from a resource handler.

methods.name: getGlobalServiceMap
methods.description: Loads and caches all service models for the current context's model, including global and component-specific services.
